### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

Run data and AI workloads anywhere.

data centers to deliver a unified cloud experience to data anywhere, powering AI anywhere without

control, security, and governance of mission-critical data, models, agents, and inference ensure
faster sovereign AI deployments.

  Amazon · Google · Microsoft · Oracle

  Oracle’s Autonomous and AI Database software running on high-performance Exadata hardware is
  available in Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud data centers all over the world.
  
  Pick the cloud you want to use.
  
  Get the same low price everywhere.
  
  [Learn more][23]
* ## AI Data Platform
  
  **AI Models in Oracle Cloud**

  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.

  Oracle Health is the first of our Application Suites to be entirely rebuilt as a set of AI Agents

  Oracle provides industry specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries.

# Connecting your enterprise, igniting its INTELLIGENCE

Backed by 25 years of continuous modernization, TIBCO’s real-time, AI-enabled composable platform
connects your enterprise, amplifying its intelligence for smarter, faster decisions.

[EXPLORE THE TIBCO PLATFORM][35]

## Accelerate with AI and
## INTELLIGENT AUTOMATION

Drive modernization with our cloud-native, real-time, [AI-enabled][36] composable data platform

[LEARN MORE][37]
* **MCP servers**
  
  Expose capabilities via MCP Server and custom Zero-Code MCP Server. By enabling user functions
  without heavy development, TIBCO provides a unified [AI platform][38].
* [**AI-driven insights***][39]
  
  [Unlock AI-powered insights*][40] for your applications: messaging, data, or platform-level. With
  integrated vector databases and advanced analytics, TIBCO transforms raw data into actionable
  intelligence.
* **Copilots and zero-code agents**
  
  Empower teams with [AI copilots*][41], app-development aids, and low-code templates to accelerate
  innovation. TIBCO enables business users and developers to build powerful, intelligent
  applications helping to democratize AI.
* **AI accelerators**
  
  Move from concept to reality quickly with features such as an AI-powered mapper and dedicated AI
  palette. With these advanced AI accelerators, TIBCO helps to fast-track development, reduce
  effort, and deliver outcomes sooner.

## The TIBCO®
## PLATFORM

The [AI-powered platform][42] for real-time
operations and insights

### MESSAGING

simplicity, reliability, and enterprise readiness.

[LEARN MORE][61]

## Achieve better
## OUTCOMES

With a future-ready, [AI-driven][62] foundation

Slide: kmemy

### **Real-time data and business response**

**Synchronize systems in real time, capitalize on data, and deliver instant business
responsiveness**

Seamlessly connect data in real time from diverse sources—legacy, edge, hybrid, and multicloud—with
low latency using secured messaging, event-driven architecture, and APIs.

Slide: phcla

### **Actionable insights and contextual intelligence**

**Get a unified view of business data and tap into comprehensive contextual intelligence for faster,
continuous decisions**

Transform data into actionable insights through real-time integration, messaging, and a powerful
in-memory data grid, with AI/ML integrated directly into workflows.

Slide: gpzzi

### **Accelerated development and insightful management**

**Streamline development, deployment, and monitoring while reducing operational overhead**

Speed solution delivery with visual low-code tools, prebuilt templates, connectors, reusable
patterns, and automated deployment.

Slide: b0449

### **Unified, scalable, and trusted platform**

**Ensure security, reliability, and flexibility across hybrid, multicloud, and edge environments**

Enable mission-critical resilience, performance, and availability through a flexible, cloud-native
framework with self-healing, auto-scaling, and unified governance.

industries achieve success with TIBCO

manage operational situations, and prevent critical events.”

 

Floriana Chiarello, Head of Demand Management

“No one is forced to go on a cruise...they go because they want to. TIBCO is working closely with
Royal Caribbean to make sure they make that choice again and again.”

“We have successfully reduced the number of cardiac arrests in the hospital by an estimated 15 to 20
percent. The system went live at 7:00 a.m., and by 10:00 a.m. that day, doctors had prevented their

— Shariq Ata, Executive Director, Data Analytics, Architecture, Integration, and Innovation

## **What Does 3u – Virtual Location Feature Do?**

To use 3uTools’ Virtual Location feature, first connect your iPhone to a Windows PC using a
Lightning cable, unlock your device, and tap “Trust” if prompted. Open Tool and wait for it to
detect your iPhone. Once detected, go to the **Tools** or **Toolbox** section and select **Virtual
Location** (or **Set Virtual Location**). Here, you can type a place name or paste latitude and
longitude coordinates to search for a specific location.

After finding the location, move or zoom the map to your exact desired spot and click **Set
Location** or **Apply**. The software will push the simulated GPS data to your device, and
location-aware apps should reflect the new position. If an app uses cached location data, you may
need to restart that app or reboot your iPhone to see the changes take effect properly. 

Before using this feature, it’s important to back up your device to prevent data loss. Only use
Virtual Location on devices you own or are authorized to control. Misusing it to bypass app
restrictions, cheat in games, or violate service policies can lead to account suspension or legal
consequences. To revert to your real location, simply reopen Virtual Location and select your true
coordinates or disconnect your device to restore standard GPS functionality.

## **What Does 3u – Virtual Location Feature Do?**

To use 3uTools’ Virtual Location feature, first connect your iPhone to a Windows PC using a

longitude coordinates to search for a specific location.

After finding the location, move or zoom the map to your exact desired spot and click **Set
Location** or **Apply**. The software will push the simulated GPS data to your device, and
location-aware apps should reflect the new position. If an app uses cached location data, you may
need to restart that app or reboot your iPhone to see the changes take effect properly.

### Win in the signal economy

In AI-driven marketing, the right signals matter more than ever. AppsFlyer’s robust signal set —
validated, fraud-filtered, and standardized — ensures your AI compounds value, not error.

AppsFlyer’s signals include unique cross-platform postbacks and creative signals for mobile and web,
as well as purchase behavior signals to reach customers with high intent.

[Win in the signal economy USP 1]

### Build on AI-ready infrastructure

AppsFlyer’s infrastructure is governed, built on proven user consent permissions, and grounded in
full-journey context — so your AI acts on the whole picture, not fragments.

Governance gives every signal traceable lineage, fraud filtering, and auditability from source to
decision, making every AI output defensible.

[Build on AI-ready infrastructure]

### Measure everything to mobile-grade standard

Mobile app performance marketing built the highest bar for signal governance in advertising.
AppsFlyer extends that proven standard across every channel and connects them together for a unified
view.

Mobile-grade measurement means optimization postbacks to every major network, multiple measurement
frameworks, advanced fraud protection, and battle-tested privacy compliance.

[Measure everything to mobile-grade standard]

### Deliver experiences your customers can’t resist

Create seamless, contextual journeys across every channel and device. AppsFlyer’s deep linking
engine turns every interaction into engagement, driving higher conversion and lasting loyalty.

Route users from email, web, social, QR, referral, or SMS to specific and relevant in-app content,
whether they have the app installed or not.

[Deliver experiences your customers can’t resist]

### Grow confidently with clean data

When bots and fake installs pollute your data, even perfect strategies fail. AppsFlyer’s fraud
protection blocks suspicious activity in real time, ensuring every decision is based on clean,
trusted data.

AppsFlyer’s AI adapts to new fraud tactics in real-time, blocking millions of threats daily –
ensuring you only measure real users and every dollar drives genuine growth.

## Stop running your marketing on fairy tales.

## Clarity for every team.
## Confidence in every decision.

### Win in the signal economy

In AI-driven marketing, the right signals matter more than ever. AppsFlyer’s robust signal set —
validated, fraud-filtered, and standardized — ensures your AI compounds value, not error.

AppsFlyer’s signals include unique cross-platform postbacks and creative signals for mobile and web,
as well as purchase behavior signals to reach customers with high intent.

[Win in the signal economy USP 1]

### Build on AI-ready infrastructure

AppsFlyer’s infrastructure is governed, built on proven user consent permissions, and grounded in
full-journey context — so your AI acts on the whole picture, not fragments.

Governance gives every signal traceable lineage, fraud filtering, and auditability from source to
decision, making every AI output defensible.

[Build on AI-ready infrastructure]

### Measure everything to mobile-grade standard

Mobile app performance marketing built the highest bar for signal governance in advertising.
AppsFlyer extends that proven standard across every channel and connects them together for a unified
view.

Mobile-grade measurement means optimization postbacks to every major network, multiple measurement
frameworks, advanced fraud protection, and battle-tested privacy compliance.

[Measure everything to mobile-grade standard]

### Deliver experiences your customers can’t resist

Create seamless, contextual journeys across every channel and device. AppsFlyer’s deep linking
engine turns every interaction into engagement, driving higher conversion and lasting loyalty.

Route users from email, web, social, QR, referral, or SMS to specific and relevant in-app content,
whether they have the app installed or not.

[Deliver experiences your customers can’t resist]

### Grow confidently with clean data

When bots and fake installs pollute your data, even perfect strategies fail. AppsFlyer’s fraud
protection blocks suspicious activity in real time, ensuring every decision is based on clean,
trusted data.

AppsFlyer’s AI adapts to new fraud tactics in real-time, blocking millions of threats daily –
ensuring you only measure real users and every dollar drives genuine growth.

[Grow confidently with clean data]

The Observation

## Enterprise AI fails not because of the model, but because of missing context

We've spent years studying how enterprises deploy AI agents. The pattern is consistent: teams build
impressive prototypes, but hit a wall when moving to production.

The wall isn't the models. It’s that no agent can reason effectively about a business it doesn't
understand — what your data means, how your teams work, how your company defines "revenue" compared
to the rest of the world.

Key Insight

When every organization has access to the same intelligence, **context becomes the differentiator**.
The enterprise that best articulates its own knowledge — its data, its processes, its meaning — will
build AI that's most useful to its people.

“We built a revenue analysis agent and it couldn't answer one question. We started to realize we
were missing this translation layer. We had no way to interpret human language against the structure
of the data.”

Joe DosSantos

VP, Enterprise Data & Analytics

The AI Context Gap

## One question for AI.
## Multiple layers of context.

Through our work with enterprises, we've found that even a simple agent task requires multiple
layers of context working together. Miss one layer and the answer breaks.

Who are our top customers this quarter?

Question It Raises

Context Layer

Answer It Needs

User Context

Who's asking — and what decision?

CS team or Sales team?

CS team optimizes for **renewal risk**

Knowledge Context

What does "customer" mean here?

Account or individual?

Parent account, **not** individual location

Meaning Context

How do you define **"top"**?

Revenue, orders, or margin?

Top = highest **net ACV**, not order count

Data Context

Which tables hold **net ACV**?

CRM vs. billing?

Use **billing.subscriptions** joined with **crm.accounts**

Data Context

How do you calculate **revenue**?

Gross or net of discounts?

Revenue net of **discounts and refunds**

## Context doesn't come from a prompt. It comes from a pipeline.

What if every agent knew what your best analyst knows? Your business systems, data estate, and
people already hold the context you need. The context pipeline makes it usable.

UNIFY

### Unify business systems in the Enterprise Data Graph

80+ connectors pull context across your entire data estate — warehouse SQL, BI definitions, and
business applications — into one living graph. That graph is what everything else in the pipeline
builds on.

CatalogGovernanceLineageQualityGlossary

### Let AI bootstrap your context layer

Atlan’s AI agents read the Enterprise Data Graph — your SQL query history, BI semantics, and
pipeline code — and generate asset descriptions, link business terms, and surface your top business
questions. The first 80% of your context layer is ready before a human reviews a single line.

### Humans resolve, annotate, and certify before context ships

The AI draft is a starting point, not the final word. Your domain experts resolve conflicts between
sources, annotate edge cases, and certify what’s production-ready. What ships is what your team
trusts.

### Certified context flows to every AI agent across your stack

The Observation

## Enterprise AI fails not because of the model, but because of missing context

We've spent years studying how enterprises deploy AI agents. The pattern is consistent: teams build
impressive prototypes, but hit a wall when moving to production.

The wall isn't the models. It’s that no agent can reason effectively about a business it doesn't
understand — what your data means, how your teams work, how your company defines "revenue" compared
to the rest of the world.

Key Insight

When every organization has access to the same intelligence, **context becomes the differentiator**.
The enterprise that best articulates its own knowledge — its data, its processes, its meaning — will
build AI that's most useful to its people.

“We built a revenue analysis agent and it couldn't answer one question. We started to realize we
were missing this translation layer. We had no way to interpret human language against the structure
of the data.”

BARC user surveys, software evaluations and expert-driven content help organizations make confident
decisions.

with concrete strategies for their organization.

### Consulting

BARC Consulting translates companies’ requirements into future-proof decisions. Our analysts combine
research, practical experience and a comprehensive market overview.

architecture to optimized, data-driven business processes. With no conflict of interest.

## How we support you

### Research

BARC user surveys, software evaluations and expert-driven content help organizations make confident
decisions.

Our independent research cuts through market complexity, rigorously evaluates software, vendors and
service providers, and shows organizations how to turn data, analytics and AI into real business
impact.

### Events

Every year, over 13,000 data & analytics experts meet at BARC conferences, roundtables and webinars.
Our events offer information, inspiration and direct exchange.

Participants learn from peers who face the same challenges and have already solved them, and leave
with concrete strategies for their organization.

### Consulting

BARC Consulting translates companies’ requirements into future-proof decisions. Our analysts combine
research, practical experience and a comprehensive market overview.

They guide organizations from data & analytics strategy and culture through the right technology and
architecture to optimized, data-driven business processes. With no conflict of interest.

# WELCOME TO CARRINGTON TEXTILES

We are a **global workwear textile manufacturer exporting to more than 80 countries**, and producing
**130 million metres of fabric annually** as a group, from our factories in **Pakistan, Portugal and
the UK**.

Throughout Europe, the Middle East, Australasia, and beyond, millions of people go about their tasks
in workwear made from our fabrics.

**Read more**

We specialise in the development of fabrics and finishes with exceptional performance in the most
demanding workplace environments. As a result, we have a reputation for innovation, and continue to
introduce exciting breakthroughs.

We develop new ideas to meet the most stringent performance requirements encountered in diverse
areas such as heavy industry, light engineering, food processing, retail, distribution,
pharmaceutical, healthcare and defence.

[Workwear Image]

### Workwear

Our workwear fabrics are the perfect solution for virtually any industry.

[EXPLORE][118]
[Flame Retardant Image]

### Flame Retardant

We are one of the biggest flame retardant fabric manufacturers in the world.

[EXPLORE][119]
[Defence Image]

### Defence

We are one of the biggest military fabric suppliers and the only Multicam licensee in Europe.

[EXPLORE][120]
[Waterproof Image]

### Waterproof

A wide range of PU coated and laminated textiles for the best waterproof fabrics.

[EXPLORE][121]
[Sustainable Image]

### Sustainable

Environmentally friendly fabrics with recycled polyester, sustainable cotton and much more.

[EXPLORE][122]

# Structured Industrial Access to Latin America for Global Manufacturers

Latin America is not a market to explore. It is a region that requires structure, qualified
representation, and a defined operational pathway. ConectNext functions as a strategic bridge
enabling industrial manufacturers and solution providers to establish a credible and effective
presence across the region.

ConectNext is not a traditional directory. It is an integrated expansion platform that combines
regional visibility, governed representation, and on-the-ground execution within a unified
operational ecosystem. We work with international companies seeking to enter and scale in Latin
America, enabling structured access to relevant decision-makers, distributors, industrial buyers,
and institutional counterparts across more than 23 strategic sectors, including Industrial
Machinery, AgriTech, Pharma, Energy, Logistics, and Advanced Materials.

Latin America encompasses a market of more than 670 million people and a combined GDP exceeding USD
6.4 trillion, representing one of the world’s most dynamic growth environments. However, successful
market entry requires far more than commercial intent. It demands local presence, regulatory
clarity, cultural alignment, and trusted operational frameworks.

Through ConectNext, organizations gain structured access to the region, supported by qualified
representation, sector-specific intelligence, and a vetted operational network. This approach
ensures that expansion into Latin America is strategic, scalable, and aligned with real commercial
opportunity — not speculation.

The platform’s full structural definition is outlined in [What Is ConectNext][19].

## Why ConectNext Is the Strategic Choice for Expansion into Latin America

ConectNext is built specifically for manufacturers, industrial technology providers, and B2B
solution firms that require a structured and reliable entry into Latin America. Expanding into the
region is not simply a commercial initiative — it is an operational decision that demands market
clarity, controlled risk, and local presence. ConectNext centralizes these capabilities within a
single, integrated expansion hub.

Our platform aligns market access, regional visibility, commercial representation, and operational
execution under one coordinated framework. This enables companies to evaluate, enter, and expand in
Latin America without opening a local office, committing to high upfront investment, or navigating
fragmented networks independently.

The ConectNext model bridges global strategy with local implementation. International intent is
translated into on-the-ground execution through governed structures. Whether the objective is to
validate demand, position a brand, establish distribution pathways, or develop long-term commercial
presence, ConectNext operates as a strategic business extension in [Colombia and across Latin
America.][20]

From sector intelligence and competitive benchmarking to trade fair participation, commercial
representation, negotiation support, and structured engagement aligned with defined mandates, we
ensure that expansion initiatives remain coordinated, professional, and grounded in real commercial
opportunity.

B2B Expansion Platform: [Scope And Participation Model][21]

## Structured Industrial Visibility

ConectNext provides a governed visibility framework within defined industrial sectors. Exposure is
structured by industry relevance, operational scope, and decision context, ensuring that visibility
is contextual, deliberate, and aligned with how industrial decisions are actually made.

## Controlled Market Presence

Market presence is established through structured positioning, representation frameworks, and
defined responsibility boundaries. Engagement occurs under clear governance rules, preserving
professional distance, accountability, and continuity without requiring premature local deployment
or uncontrolled intermediaries.

## Decision-Grade Market Intelligence

ConectNext delivers sector-specific analysis, structural demand signals, and competitive context

#### [What customization options are available for your products?][47]

We provide comprehensive OEM/ODM services, allowing for extensive customization of our products to
meet your specific requirements. This includes customization of color, size, temperature resistance,
packaging, and more. Our goal is to ensure that the final product aligns perfectly with your needs
and application requirements.

#### [Do you offer free samples of your products, and how can I request them?][48]

Yes, we offer free samples of our products to help you assess their quality and suitability for your
needs. However, please note that customers from certain countries or regions may need to cover the
cost of courier services. To request your free sample, simply contact us with your details and
specific product interests, and we’ll guide you through the process.

#### [Can the Food Grade Teflon Mesh Conveyor Belt be customized for different food processing
#### environments?][49]

Absolutely! We specialize in customizing our Food Grade Teflon Mesh Conveyor Belt to meet the
specific needs of your food processing environment. Whether you require different sizes, shapes, or
temperature resistances, our OEM/ODM services are designed to tailor the perfect solution for your
operation, ensuring efficiency and compliance with food safety standards.

#### [What are the main applications of your PTFE Coated Fiberglass Fabric?][50]

Our PTFE Coated Fiberglass Fabric is ideal for a wide range of applications, including
high-temperature insulation, conveyor belts for food processing, protective coverings in chemical
processing, and as a non-stick surface for baking and drying. Its superior heat resistance and
non-stick properties make it versatile for industrial, commercial, and culinary uses.

#### [How does High Temperature PTFE Adhesive Tape withstand extreme conditions?][51]

Our High Temperature PTFE Adhesive Tape is engineered for performance under extreme conditions,
withstanding temperatures up to 260°C (500°F). It’s designed with a high-grade PTFE coating that
ensures a non-stick surface and excellent chemical resistance, making it suitable for sealing,
masking, and insulation in demanding environments.

Analysts review questionnaires, track responses across systems, chase vendors over email for weeks.

[Book a Demo][30]

## Your controls run the whole lifecycle

Most risk tools are built around their own logic.
Coverbase is built around yours.

Coverbase spans six stages of the vendor lifecycle: intake, zero-touch assessment, risk copilot,
continuous monitoring, inspection, and contracts. Each stage feeds the others. Intake improves
assessment. Assessment powers risk decisions. Risk insights shape monitoring and inspection.
Inspection and monitoring refine contract terms. Contract obligations define what gets tracked.
Signals loop back into intake and reassessment. The longer Coverbase runs, the more it mirrors how
your team evaluates risk. This is not a workflow tool. It’s infrastructure that compounds.

Stage 1

### Autonomous Intake

Know exactly who you're onboarding before you ask a single question.

Coverbase researches every new supplier automatically -- scanning public attack surface, financials,
OFAC, adverse media, and product data -- then pre-fills your inherent risk questionnaire so your
team reviews, not re-enters.

Stage 2

### Zero-touch Assessments

Fully assess low-risk vendors without sending a single questionnaire.

Coverbase pulls from security, compliance, legal, financial, and registration APIs automatically --
reading trust centers, public filings, and paid data sources -- so your team gets a completed
assessment, not a blank form to route.

Stage 3

### Risk Assessment Copilot

Accelerate third-party risk assessments by 92%.

Automatically analyze questionnaires, contracts, and third-party evidence against your custom
controls. Detect exceptions, generate follow-ups -- and train the model on your team's decisions so
every assessment gets faster and more accurate over time.

Stage 4

### Supplier Radar

Continuously monitor suppliers across every risk domain.

Combine internal and external feeds into a third-party SIEM to detect supplier issues early, trigger
automated outreach, confirm blast radius, and close the case -- with every incident feeding back
into assessments, contracts, and risk scores.

Stage 5

### Coverbase Inspect

See inside every vendor's environment.

Give Coverbase read-only access to a vendor application and an AI agent inspects security settings,
access controls, and integrations automatically -- surfacing findings directly in the vendor's risk
profile.

Stage 6

### Contract Guardian

Turn contracts into living risk controls.

Extract obligations, SLAs, and breach terms from every vendor contract. Monitor performance against
real data, flag deviations automatically, and feed assessment findings back as contract addendums --
closing the loop between risk and legal.

## Trusted by Learners & Partners at

[People working at table][People working at table]

## The Global Leader in Data Management Education.

Capitalize on the **single best source of education** for anyone harnessing the power of data —
business leaders, data management practitioners and IT professionals worldwide.

**Our mission is to make data education accessible, practical, and impactful** — helping you solve
today’s toughest challenges, advance your career, and drive meaningful change in your organization.
* Finding data governance training material isn’t always easy. At the DATAVERSITY Training Center,
  there is a vast selection of content in a variety of disciplines.
  
  Donald J. LeMay, CIMP, CDS
  Data Governance Analyst, Amica
* Exceeded expectations. The caliber of presentations, relationships developed, and knowledge gained
  are all priceless. This is the place to come to meet like-minded colleagues and learn from
  industry thought leaders and practitioners.
  
  Stephanie M Davis
  Data Governance Analyst, PTC
* All of the courses and sections were broken into parts that could be readily digested for
  efficient learning. This helped me compartmentalize my entire training program.
  
  A recent DATAVERSITY Training Center student
  United States Military
* DATAVERSITY’s training is created by industry thought leaders and consummate professionals with
  years of experience. There is no more impactful collection of training videos on data governance
  or data management on the web.
  
  Guy Gore
  Data Governance Analyst, Fortune 500 financial services company


## Find Your People, Fuel Your Passion.

Without access to breakthrough knowledge and networking, growth can feel out of reach. We believe
collaboration doesn’t just lighten the load — it multiplies your impact. Join a community you can
count on.

DATAVERSITY in-person conferences and online events directly connect you with industry leaders,
peers, and cutting-edge solutions to tackle your toughest data challenges head-on.

[Explore Upcoming Events][38]

[ [Conference logo][Conference logo] ][39]

## DGIQ + AIGov 2026

November 16-19, 2026 | Providence, Rhode Island

[ Register Now ][40] [ Learn More ][41]

## The Gold Standard in Data Management Certification & Training.

Build unshakable credibility with DATAVERSITY’s certification programs.

### Applied Data Governance Certification

Establish your credibility as a data governance leader.

Earn industry-recognized certification that demonstrates your expertise in building effective
governance programs. Designed to provide real-world application of governance practices, you’ll
learn to implement frameworks, engage stakeholders, and solve complex governance challenges
effectively.

[ Get Certified ][42]

### CDMP Certification Training

Study smarter — not harder.

DATAVERSITY offers the leading DAMA-International-endorsed CDMP Certification Training for data
professionals.

Our expert-led training makes it simple to understand and master the DMBOK concepts. With clear
objectives, expert guidance, and comprehensive resources, we help you target what matters most.

[ Start Studying ][43]
[woman-speaking-at-conference-min][woman-speaking-at-conference-min]

Women in Data Management & Governance is a community dedicated to amplifying women and marginalized
genders, championing authentic leadership, and fostering a culture where empowerment and growth take
center stage.

Explore resources, workshops, and networking opportunities designed to help women overcome barriers
and achieve leadership roles in the field.

The future of data is inclusive — Women in Data Management & Governance at DATAVERSITY is leading
the charge.

[Join Our Community][44]

## Learn Anywhere, Anytime.

## Data, Metadata and Operations Software for Media Companies

Fabric delivers end-to-end data and operations solutions that connect content creation, media
operations, metadata, and market intelligence — from production to audience engagement.

## **Agent-Ready**** by Design**

## Agent-Ready by Design

The next generation of media workflows won't be driven only by people in UIs — they'll be executed
by autonomous agents working through governed machine interfaces. Fabric's platforms are built for
both. Every product line exposes an MCP server with OAuth-governed access — each agent identity's
permissions determine the tools it can use — alongside documented REST APIs, webhooks, and
machine-readable documentation.

### [Xytech X2 MCP][21]

Agents create and update orders, schedule resources, and drive media workflows through the X2 MCP
server — with OAuth permissions scoped per tool, so enterprises delegate exactly the operational
authority they choose.

### [Origin Studio MCP][22]

One unified MCP server across Origin Studio and Nexus. Agents query source-of-truth title metadata
and execute catalog operations, with OAuth rights dictating tool access per identity.

### [Origin Insights MCP][23]

Governed natural-language access to 1.5B+ market data points across 1,000+ platforms and 249
countries. OAuth-based, built for elastic agent workloads.

REST APIs with machine-readable schemas · Webhooks and event-driven workflows · llms.txt and
markdown docs for agent consumption · Tool-level OAuth governance · ISO/IEC 27001 certified

## Data, Metadata and Operations Software for Media Companies

Fabric delivers end-to-end data and operations solutions that connect content creation, media
operations, metadata, and market intelligence — from production to audience engagement.

## **Agent-Ready**** by Design**

## Agent-Ready by Design

The next generation of media workflows won't be driven only by people in UIs — they'll be executed
by autonomous agents working through governed machine interfaces. Fabric's platforms are built for
both. Every product line exposes an MCP server with OAuth-governed access — each agent identity's
permissions determine the tools it can use — alongside documented REST APIs, webhooks, and
machine-readable documentation.

### [Xytech X2 MCP][21]

Agents create and update orders, schedule resources, and drive media workflows through the X2 MCP
server — with OAuth permissions scoped per tool, so enterprises delegate exactly the operational
authority they choose.

### [Origin Studio MCP][22]

One unified MCP server across Origin Studio and Nexus. Agents query source-of-truth title metadata
and execute catalog operations, with OAuth rights dictating tool access per identity.

### [Origin Insights MCP][23]

Governed natural-language access to 1.5B+ market data points across 1,000+ platforms and 249
countries. OAuth-based, built for elastic agent workloads.

REST APIs with machine-readable schemas · Webhooks and event-driven workflows · llms.txt and
markdown docs for agent consumption · Tool-level OAuth governance · ISO/IEC 27001 certified

# Trusted Consulting Firm for Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, & Power BI

## Transforming fragmented data to unified, AI-ready architectures that drive measurable business
## impact

***19x Consecutive Quarters
******G2 High Performer
***

***4x Consecutive Years on
******Inc. 5000***

## Strategic Partners for Your Most Important Data & AI Initiatives

We’re not developers. We’re not just consultants. We’re your strategic business partners with
unrivaled experience and expertise across the Microsoft Data Stack.

Collectiv is a Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI), Microsoft Fabric Featured Partner,
Databricks Consulting Partner, a Select Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network Services
Track, and G2’s top-rated Microsoft consulting firm. Our experts have a true understanding of how to
interlink architecture, analytics, and AI to drive successful data initiatives.

Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Copilot, and Claude are the tools that will make an impact on your
journey and the tools that we specialize in. As your partner, Collectiv empowers informed
data-driven decisions throughout your organization.

[Microsoft Copilot Consulting]

## Unrivaled Experience and Expertise Across the Microsoft Data Stack

[Microsoft Fabric Consulting Services]

## Fabric

With Fabric, all your data is finally unified into a single platform and seamlessly layering AI on
top of data processes is easier than ever. But, how will your team adopt an entirely new way of
accessing, managing, and acting on organizational data?

Our Fabric experts provide the best approach for integrating disparate data sources and customizing
solutions that fit your business needs and your team’s technical abilities. We’ll help you leave
your old data silos behind and move into a new streamlined era.


[ Fabric Consulting ][146]
[Databricks & Fabric Lakehouse Accelerator]

## Databricks

Databricks unifies data engineering, analytics, and machine learning on a single platform built for
scale. But harnessing its full potential requires deep technical expertise and a strategy aligned
with your organization’s data goals.

Collectiv’s Databricks consultants design, build, and optimize your lakehouse architecture to drive
AI innovation and more efficient collaboration between teams. Whether you’re migrating from legacy
systems or expanding advanced analytics, we help you deploy Databricks solutions that unlock
performance, scalability, and innovation.

[ Databricks Consulting ][147]
[Power BI Consulting Services]

## Power BI

Data is your most powerful asset. But, your team is likely challenged by disconnected systems,
governance challenges, and decision paralysis. The only thing stopping your team from reaping the
benefits of Power BI is technical know-how and business acumen.

Collectiv, originally dubbed the “Power BI experts,” brings this unique combination. As the earliest
adopters of Power BI, we’ve tackled every imaginable analytics challenge. We’ll help you bridge the
gap between data and decisions with our proven Power BI solutions.

[ Power BI Consulting ][148]

## Vetted Fabric Experts That Microsoft Stands Behind

If you’re searching for Fabric implementation support, you want Microsoft-vetted experts. Collectiv
is a Fabric Featured Partner, and we have the experience and expertise to tackle any of your Fabric
initiatives.

[See Partnership Details][149]

### Resources we recommend

[Dynamic Formatting in Power BI]

### Dynamic Formatting in Power BI

Power BI's auto units setting can round big numbers inaccurately. Learn how dynamic formatting in
Power BI uses DAX to fix it.
][150]
[
[Power BI Report Accessibility]

### Power BI Report Accessibility: A Practical WCAG Guide

Learn how to make Power BI reports accessible using WCAG principles, from color-independent charts
to keyboard navigation and screen readers.
][151]
[
[Microsoft Fabric Plan]

### What Is Microsoft Fabric Plan? Guide, Pricing, and Setup

Learn what Microsoft Fabric Plan is, how its pricing works, and how it connects to Power BI without
duplicating data. Watch the demo.
][152]
[ See all resources ][153]

## Data Services That Make an Impact

#### Data Strategy

Craft a tailored executable data strategy with expert guidance that ensures every organizational
data initiative meets desired stakeholder outcomes.

#### Data Architecture

Bring all your disparate data and systems into a unified data infrastructure to provide
organization-wide scalability, adaptability, and clarity.

#### Implementation

Implement Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Copilot, and the entire Microsoft Data Stack to streamline
operations, drive efficiency, and create business impact.

#### Strategic Support

Achieve quick tactical outcomes for a specific project or general execution with an adaptive,
on-demand framework where our experts support your team’s efforts.

#### Training

Enable your team to maximize the capabilities of the Microsoft Data Stack through immersive,
instructor-led courses that expand skill sets at any level.

#### Planning

Implement advanced Microsoft xP&A capabilities to consolidate processes and enable flexible,
accurate, real-time data-driven budgeting, planning, and forecasting.

# Trusted Consulting Firm for Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, & Power BI

## Transforming fragmented data to unified, AI-ready architectures that drive measurable business
## impact

***19x Consecutive Quarters
******G2 High Performer
***

***4x Consecutive Years on
******Inc. 5000***

## Strategic Partners for Your Most Important Data & AI Initiatives

We’re not developers. We’re not just consultants. We’re your strategic business partners with
unrivaled experience and expertise across the Microsoft Data Stack.

Collectiv is a Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI), Microsoft Fabric Featured Partner,
Databricks Consulting Partner, a Select Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network Services
Track, and G2’s top-rated Microsoft consulting firm. Our experts have a true understanding of how to
interlink architecture, analytics, and AI to drive successful data initiatives.

Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Copilot, and Claude are the tools that will make an impact on your
journey and the tools that we specialize in. As your partner, Collectiv empowers informed
data-driven decisions throughout your organization.

[Microsoft Copilot Consulting]

## Unrivaled Experience and Expertise Across the Microsoft Data Stack

[Microsoft Fabric Consulting Services]

## Fabric

With Fabric, all your data is finally unified into a single platform and seamlessly layering AI on
top of data processes is easier than ever. But, how will your team adopt an entirely new way of
accessing, managing, and acting on organizational data?

Our Fabric experts provide the best approach for integrating disparate data sources and customizing
solutions that fit your business needs and your team’s technical abilities. We’ll help you leave
your old data silos behind and move into a new streamlined era.


[ Fabric Consulting ][146]
[Databricks & Fabric Lakehouse Accelerator]

## Databricks

Databricks unifies data engineering, analytics, and machine learning on a single platform built for
scale. But harnessing its full potential requires deep technical expertise and a strategy aligned
with your organization’s data goals.

Collectiv’s Databricks consultants design, build, and optimize your lakehouse architecture to drive
AI innovation and more efficient collaboration between teams. Whether you’re migrating from legacy
systems or expanding advanced analytics, we help you deploy Databricks solutions that unlock
performance, scalability, and innovation.

[ Databricks Consulting ][147]
[Power BI Consulting Services]

## Power BI

Data is your most powerful asset. But, your team is likely challenged by disconnected systems,
governance challenges, and decision paralysis. The only thing stopping your team from reaping the
benefits of Power BI is technical know-how and business acumen.

Collectiv, originally dubbed the “Power BI experts,” brings this unique combination. As the earliest
adopters of Power BI, we’ve tackled every imaginable analytics challenge. We’ll help you bridge the
gap between data and decisions with our proven Power BI solutions.

[ Power BI Consulting ][148]

## Vetted Fabric Experts That Microsoft Stands Behind

If you’re searching for Fabric implementation support, you want Microsoft-vetted experts. Collectiv
is a Fabric Featured Partner, and we have the experience and expertise to tackle any of your Fabric
initiatives.

[See Partnership Details][149]

#### Data Strategy

Craft a tailored executable data strategy with expert guidance that ensures every organizational
data initiative meets desired stakeholder outcomes.

#### Data Architecture

Bring all your disparate data and systems into a unified data infrastructure to provide
organization-wide scalability, adaptability, and clarity.

#### Implementation

Implement Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Copilot, and the entire Microsoft Data Stack to streamline
operations, drive efficiency, and create business impact.

#### Strategic Support

Achieve quick tactical outcomes for a specific project or general execution with an adaptive,
on-demand framework where our experts support your team’s efforts.

#### Training

Enable your team to maximize the capabilities of the Microsoft Data Stack through immersive,
instructor-led courses that expand skill sets at any level.

#### Planning

Implement advanced Microsoft xP&A capabilities to consolidate processes and enable flexible,
accurate, real-time data-driven budgeting, planning, and forecasting.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Agentic BI?

Agentic BI is an analytics approach where specialized AI agents autonomously handle data querying,
dashboard creation, report generation, alerting, and delivery. Instead of manually building queries
and dashboards, you describe what you need in plain English and agents handle the work across your
connected data sources.

Can Knowi connect to MongoDB and SQL at the same time?

Yes. Knowi natively connects to 70+ data sources including MongoDB, SQL databases, Elasticsearch,
REST APIs, and cloud services. You can join data across these sources in a single query without
requiring a data warehouse or ETL pipeline.

How does Knowi's private AI work?

Knowi runs its own AI models, inference engine, and vector search on Knowi-managed infrastructure.
No third-party LLM ever sees your queries or results. For on-premise deployments, all AI processing
stays within your own environment.

Does Knowi support on-premise deployment?

Yes. Knowi can be deployed on-premise using Docker or Kubernetes, on Knowi's SOC 2 Type II compliant
cloud, or in a hybrid configuration. All features including AI agents work in every deployment mode.

What data sources does Knowi support?

Knowi connects to 70+ data sources including SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server), NoSQL
databases (MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, InfluxDB), REST APIs, cloud services (Salesforce,
HubSpot, Google Analytics), and file uploads (CSV, Excel, JSON).

How is Knowi different from Tableau or Power BI?

Knowi connects directly to raw data sources without requiring a data warehouse, supports native
NoSQL and API connections, runs its own private AI for data privacy, and includes AI agents that
autonomously build queries, dashboards, and reports from natural language questions.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Agentic BI?

Agentic BI is an analytics approach where specialized AI agents autonomously handle data querying,
dashboard creation, report generation, alerting, and delivery. Instead of manually building queries
and dashboards, you describe what you need in plain English and agents handle the work across your
connected data sources.

Can Knowi connect to MongoDB and SQL at the same time?

Yes. Knowi natively connects to 70+ data sources including MongoDB, SQL databases, Elasticsearch,
REST APIs, and cloud services. You can join data across these sources in a single query without
requiring a data warehouse or ETL pipeline.

How does Knowi's private AI work?

Knowi runs its own AI models, inference engine, and vector search on Knowi-managed infrastructure.
No third-party LLM ever sees your queries or results. For on-premise deployments, all AI processing
stays within your own environment.

Does Knowi support on-premise deployment?

Yes. Knowi can be deployed on-premise using Docker or Kubernetes, on Knowi's SOC 2 Type II compliant
cloud, or in a hybrid configuration. All features including AI agents work in every deployment mode.

What data sources does Knowi support?

Knowi connects to 70+ data sources including SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server), NoSQL
databases (MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, InfluxDB), REST APIs, cloud services (Salesforce,
HubSpot, Google Analytics), and file uploads (CSV, Excel, JSON).

How is Knowi different from Tableau or Power BI?

Knowi connects directly to raw data sources without requiring a data warehouse, supports native
NoSQL and API connections, runs its own private AI for data privacy, and includes AI agents that
autonomously build queries, dashboards, and reports from natural language questions.

answers.

When you need a hand, just reach out. We’re here, right on the other side of the screen. Real people

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Can I cancel my paid subscription at any time?

Yes. You can cancel your plan at any time. You can continue to enjoy your payment plan until the end
of the current billing cycle. Once it is terminated, your account will become free.

Can the plan be extended at any time?

If you want to upgrade your plan, you can do so anytime. The paid and unused portion of the previous
plan will be deducted from the price of the new plan.

Is it possible to connect several Google Business Profiles under the same brand?

Each Metricool brand corresponds to a single location, so you’ll need a separate brand for each
Google Business Profile. This allows you to schedule tailored content and track performance
independently for each location. If you want combined reports across multiple brands, you can do
this using the Looker Studio Connector (available on the Advanced Plan), which lets you include data
from several brands in a single custom report.

What is a brand in Metricool?

Each brand in Metricool represents a business, brand, or customer. Under each brand, you can manage
1 profile for each social network or ad platform.

What are the main differences between a STARTER and ADVANCED plan?

The **ADVANCED plan** offers everything in the Starter plan, plus additional features to manage more
brands and streamline your workflow:
**Collaborators:** Give clients or team members access to a specific brand without exposing data
from others.
**Looker Studio & API access:** Create in-depth, customized reports and connect Metricool with other
tools.
**Custom report templates:** Design reports that fit your needs and branding.
**Zapier integration:** Automate processes and save time on repetitive tasks.

Is Metricool free?

Yes! You can use Metricool for free, forever. With our Free plan, you can connect 1 brand associated
to a profile for each social network, plan your content, publish content automatically, manage
messages from your networks, and more.

Can I downgrade my current subscription?

Yes. You can switch to a lower plan at any time, and the change will take effect at the end of your
current billing period.

Where can I download my invoices?

Invoices are automatically generated once payment by card or PayPal has been made. They can be
downloaded from your account settings. It can also be set up to automatically, so you receive them
in your email.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

## What Exactly Is MiniTool Partition Wizard?

[All-in-one Disk Partition Manager]

### All-in-one Disk Partition Manager

As best partition manager for Windows, MiniTool Partition Wizard aims to maximize disk performance.
It helps create/resize/format partition flexibly, convert disk between MBR and GPT disks, convert
partition between NTFS and FAT32, and convert dynamic disk to basic without data loss in a few
clicks.

[Powerful BitLocker Encryption Manager]

### Powerful BitLocker Encryption Manager New Feature

Designed for users who work with encrypted drives, BitLocker Manager brings BitLocker support into
partition and disk management workflows, helping maintain both data protection and flexible disk
management.

[Smart Duplicate Files Cleaner]

### Smart Duplicate Files Cleaner

Duplicate Cleaner can quickly locate and remove duplicate files on your PC and external drives,
instantly freeing up storage space. It helps you effortlessly identify unnecessary copies hiding in
every folder, clean up clutter, and make room for new data.

[Effective Data Recovery Program]

### Effective Data Recovery Program

MiniTool partition manager software offers two perfect solutions for data recovery. Partition
Recovery Wizard can find and recover the lost partitions while Data Recovery feature can recognize
and recover lost/deleted files from damaged, formatted, inaccessible FAT/NTFS/exFAT drives and
Desktop/Recycle Bin/specified folders.

([Which edition should you get for Data Recovery?][34])

[Powerful Disk Clone Tool]

### Powerful Disk Clone Tool

Disk clone or system migration is most frequently used to back up and upgrade hard drive. Disk
cloning works perfectly when you are forced to make an instant backup. System migration returns you
to act on the new disk in a while. No need to spend hours reinstalling operating system and
applications.

[Striking Disk Diagnostic Master]

### Striking Disk Diagnostic Master

As comprehensive disk check master, MiniTool Partition Wizard can measure disk read/write speed,
analyze disk usage on computer, verify the file system integrity of a volume and fix logical file
system errors, and quickly detect if there are bad sectors on the drive.

[Get Partition Wizard][35]

## Who Is Using MiniTool Partition Wizard?

Home and Home Office

Today most home and home office users choose MiniTool Partition Wizard to redistribute hard drives
and convert disk partition within simple steps.

Server Users

Server users always rate MiniTool Partition Wizard as their first choice for it bolsters data
security protection and boosts server performance.

Enterprise Users

For enterprises and technicians, more editions are provided so that they are able to deploy MiniTool
Partition Wizard on multiple computers.

## Why MiniTool Partition Wizard?

Trusted by Millions of Editors and Clients

[Reviews (24)][36]

Windows's built-in disk management utility does an adequate job of letting you manage your PC's
partitions, but if you want to perform a deeper dive into your PC's hard drive (or drives!), check
out MiniTool Partition Wizard...

BY JEFFREY L. WILSON


MiniTool’s Partition Wizard is an ideal tool that’ll help you manage the files on your PC more

## **What Makes Data ****Agentic-Ready****?**

AI agents are only as trustworthy as the data they act on. Most enterprise data isn’t ready.
Agentic-Ready Data is visible, reliable, accountable, and complete.  That’s the higher standard AI
needs to operate with confidence.

[1 icon]

### UNIFIEDMake your data visible

Enterprise data exists across every signal and every system, but not always in a way AI can see or
understand. Make it available, connected, and easy to navigate so AI can discover and use it
wherever decisions are made.

[2 icon]

### HIGH QUALITYMake your data reliable

Agents move fast, and AI doesn’t pause to validate bad inputs. Keep your data accurate, complete,
consistent, and continuously monitored so every AI decision starts with trusted information.

[3 icon]

### GOVERNEDMake your data accountable

As AI starts acting on your behalf, transparency and control become non-negotiable. Make every AI
decision based on data that is traceable, explainable, and governed by business policies, so AI
operates responsibly.

[4 icon]

### ENRICHEDMake your data complete

Your internal data alone isn’t enough for agentic AI. Adding rich location, business, and consumer
context gives AI the complete picture it needs to understand, reason, and act with confidence.

[Link icon]

Data must meet all these conditions continuously, wherever decisions are made. The Precisely Data
Integrity Suite makes your data AI-ready in one unified system, so agents can drive business
outcomes at enterprise scale.

# Wire Your Enterprise For Trusted Agentic Analytics

##### Mantra AI Insights Fabric automatically connects agents to the right data and context on the
##### fly to deliver trusted insights.

##### Powered by the first Insights Context Graph that builds validated responses based on user
##### intent, multi-dimensional context, and live data.

##### The fastest way to context-driven trusted insights for all users and agents across all
##### enterprise data.

[ Wire Your Enterprise Today! ][80] [ See How It Works ][81]

###### WHY IT MATTERS

## Enterprise Architecture is Not Wired for Agentic Analytics.

##### Data is Distributed

Your data lives across dozens of platforms. No AI sees it all.

##### Context is Fragmented

Business logic, definitions, and tribal knowledge are scattered across tools and people’s heads.

##### Accuracy is Unverifiable

In a pilot, you can check every answer. At enterprise scale, there’s no way to know what’s wrong.

#### The result? Trust erodes, adoption stalls, and AI stays stuck in pilot mode.

THE SOLUTION

## Mantra Wires Your Enterprise for Trusted Agentic Analytics.

 

[Mantra AI Insights Fabric Architecture]

 

#### Your data stays where it is — Mantra queries it live across every platform.

#### Context from catalogs, semantic models, and business rules feeds the Insights Context Graph, so
#### every question maps to the right knowledge.

#### And every answer is validated and explainable before it reaches you.

[ Learn How it Works ][82]

###### SEE IT IN ACTION

## Get Trusted Insights From All Your Data. Anywhere.

 

 

#### Same question. Same AI.
#### Add Mantra, and it actually works on your enterprise data.

###### USE CASES

## Three Ways Mantra Transforms How You Use Data.

##### AI Analyst
* **Who:** Data and business analysts
* **What:** Build data products across all enterprise data sources
* **Impact:** 50× faster from question to production-ready insight

* **Who:** Business users and executives
* **What:** Ask questions through tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot
* **Impact:** Trusted answers across all your enterprise data, instantly

* **Who:** Agents and applications
* **What:** Context and data delivered on demand via API
* **Impact:** Invisible infrastructure powering enterprise AI at scale

[Careers][131] * [Contact Us][132] * [Request a Demo][133] # **Agentic identities** are sprawling at unprecedented rates
Radiant Logic has unified fragmented, ungovernable identity data for over 20 years. That same identity data platform now extends to the AI-enabled enterprise, unifying human, non-human, and agentic identities into one authoritative source of truth. ### RadiantOne ## The Data Foundation for Your IAM Program Every downstream tool, policy, and AI access decision depends on context. We make sure that context is accurate, complete, and trusted. Unify Observe Act Powered by AIDA Artificial Intelligence Data Assistant ### Unify * Aggregate, correlate, cleanse, and synchronize human, non-human, and agentic identity data from hundreds of sources into a single authoritative cloud * Power every downstream IAM tool, AI model, and automated workflow to operate with full context * Eliminate the blind spots that leave your security stack exposed and enforce smarter, context-aware policies ### Observe * Continuously monitor access paths, entitlements, and identity changes across across every identity: human, non-human, and agents * Automatically detect orphaned, dormant access, policy drift, and emerging risks * Maintain a complete, always-current picture of who or what has access to what and whether it’s justified ### Act * Move from insight to action with AI-assisted, human-in-loop workflows across humans, non-humans, and agents * Remediate, validate, and orchestrate responses across your IAM and security stack * Leverage Shared Signals Framework (SSF) to coordinate access revocation, kill-switch scenarios, and closed-loop response with PAM, SIEM, XDR, and Zero Trust Controls ### Powered by AIDA Artificial Intelligence Data Assistant * Reveal identity relationships across users, accounts, roles, permissions, agents, and systems * Pinpoint anomalies, excessive privilege, and risky behavior across every identity class * Recommend and guide remediation with explainable, auditable outcomes [Explore Platform][134] ## What Our Customers are Saying [ [A man in a suit and glasses sits in an office, discussing identity data. On-screen text reads: Rajnish Bhatia, Vice President, Cyber Security, Comcast. A plant and conference table are in the background.] ][135] #### [ Comcast: Ensuring Full Visibility of Identity Data for More Accurate Provisioning ][136] In this customer video testimonial, Comcast’s Vice President of Cybersecurity explains their large, complex IAM ecosystem that covers multiple user types and how Radiant Logic provides the company with full visibility of identity data that helps them accurately provision downstream applications. left and the text NBCUniversal in dark blue on a white background, representing a trusted visual identity in media where safeguarding identity data is paramount.] [Southern California Edison logo featuring a stylized white sunburst on a blue square, with the words Southern California Edison in blue uppercase letters to the right of the sunburst.] [Fidelity Investments logo with a stylized sunburst graphic on the left and the company name in bold, dark blue text on a light gray background, reflecting trust and security in handling identity data.] [AdventHealth logo with dark blue text and a stylized four-leaf design above the letter t on a light background, reflecting a reassuring brand presence while emphasizing secure management of identity data.] [Air France-KLM Group logo with the words AIRFRANCEKLM GROUP in bold, dark blue uppercase letters on a light background, reflecting a strong and unified brand identity that underscores the importance of secure identity data within the organization.] #### Director of IAM “Radiant Logic has allowed us to centralize identity functions, enabled role-based access provisioning, and helped reduce security risks, while improving our overall ability to remain regulatory compliant.” #### Director of Identity & Domain Services, Healthcare & Biotech “As we migrate away from our legacy IGA platform, Radiant is playing a core role in our Identity modernization project. It has become our Single Pane of Glass for all identities in our organization. It has been a great partnership with Radiant as it has been the most important portion of our IGA architecture.” #### Head of IAM Insurance “It’s truly one of the few solutions that delivers so many valuable features right out of the box. This product’s real-time data visibility and intuitive interface make it an outstanding tool for monitoring identity vulnerabilities and quickly understanding the health of our company’s access management.” #### ICAM Architect, Department of Homeland Security “Being able to provide one magical source of a bunch of data to your downstream systems is huge. Now whether the organization or company uses SailPoint or whether it’s Okta, whether it’s Savyint or whatever it is, just a single source of identity data is huge, for an identity system or provisioning system, any workflow system.” #### Senior Identity Architect, North American Energy Producer “RadiantOne helped us to sunset and migrate away from multiple technology platforms and legacy directories down to the RadiantOne platform, reducing redundant infrastructure. Yes. You can add a single item to your procurement list as a sample request. We will consolidate
samples from multiple factories to save shipping costs.

Can you source custom products (OEM)?

Absolutely. Send us your design drawings or technical requirements, and we will find a qualified
factory to manufacture it for you.

### Over 100 high performance connectors and Change Data Capture

Striim makes it easy to connect to popular sources like databases in GCP, AWS, or Azure with a point
and click wizard. Select tables, migrate schemas, and start moving data to your warehouse or message
queues in seconds.
* [ See How it Works ][61]

### Integration for AI and ML

Turn your relational and unstructured data into AI-ready vectors and automated insights in
real-time. Leverage Striim’s built in machine learning functions to generate intelligent actions to
systems of engagement and build AI-powered customer experiences.
* [ See How it Works ][62]

### Intelligent Schema Evolution

With Striim’s schema evolution capabilities, you can have full control whenever data drifts. Capture
schema changes, configure how each consumer propagates the change or simply halt and alert when a
manual resolution is needed.
* [ See How it Works ][63]

### Streaming SQL

Striim is built on a distributed, streaming SQL platform. Run transformations on streaming data like
queries, joins with historical caches, and scale up to billions of events per minute.
* [ See How it Works ][64]

### Data Pipeline Monitoring

Visualize your pipeline health, end-to-end data latency, and table-level metrics. Monitor from
Striim’s dashboard and get alerted where you pay attention most. Plug in with Striim’s REST APIs and
automate alerts even further.

### Over 100 high performance connectors and Change Data Capture

Striim makes it easy to connect to popular sources like databases in GCP, AWS, or Azure with a point
and click wizard. Select tables, migrate schemas, and start moving data to your warehouse or message
queues in seconds.
* [ See How it Works ][61]

### Integration for AI and ML

Turn your relational and unstructured data into AI-ready vectors and automated insights in
real-time. Leverage Striim’s built in machine learning functions to generate intelligent actions to
systems of engagement and build AI-powered customer experiences.
* [ See How it Works ][62]

### Intelligent Schema Evolution

With Striim’s schema evolution capabilities, you can have full control whenever data drifts. Capture
schema changes, configure how each consumer propagates the change or simply halt and alert when a
manual resolution is needed.
* [ See How it Works ][63]

### Streaming SQL

Striim is built on a distributed, streaming SQL platform. Run transformations on streaming data like
queries, joins with historical caches, and scale up to billions of events per minute.
* [ See How it Works ][64]

### Data Pipeline Monitoring

Visualize your pipeline health, end-to-end data latency, and table-level metrics. Monitor from
Striim’s dashboard and get alerted where you pay attention most. Plug in with Striim’s REST APIs and
automate alerts even further.
* [ See How it Works ][65]

Comfort|Design|Color|Performance|Sustainability|

set new standards for how materials enhance the way we live, work, and connect.

[View Collections][69]
The home of *award-winning* performance fabrics.
For half a century, Ultrafabrics has continually reinvented the world of animal-free performance
fabrics by pairing uncompromising craftsmanship with cutting-edge innovation test.

Our premium and intelligent fabrics elevate your senses in every way, while delivering unmatched
benefits in durability, cleanability, breathability and more.

* [Cabernet]

  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
   
* [Breathable Distressed]
  
  # Brisa Distressed
  
  Brisa Distressed delivers a rustic, natural grain aesthetic with all the performance benefits that
  define our renowned Brisa collection. Engineered with breathable airflow technology, it delivers

  —from upholstery to vertical and horizontal panels.
  
  Brisa Distressed’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon.
  Each linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
