  # Brisa Forecast
  
  Boundary-pushing performance is the hallmark of Brisa Forecast. Climate control technology shields
  against temperature changes while breathability provides ultimate seating comfort and softness.
  Featuring water repellency, EPA-registered mildew defense, solar endurance, and colorfastness,
  it’s ideal for outdoor residential applications.
  
  Between its subtly textured aesthetic and palette of classic shades, Brisa Forecast brings
  understated style to any space — indoors or outdoors.
  
  Brisa Forecast’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each
  linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
  
  *Formally known as Brisa Original Outdoor. Outdoor applications for Residential use only.*
* [Breathable Frontier]
  
  # Brisa Frontier
  
  Brisa Frontier takes a rustic, natural aesthetic and infuses it with intelligent performance
  features: airflow circulation for breathable comfort, climate control technology to shield against
  temperature changes, solar endurance to prevent fading, water repellency, and EPA-registered
  mildew defense — just to name a few. Available in a versatile palette of classic hues, Brisa
  Frontier combines functionality and flexibility, making it perfect for residential outdoor
  application or indoor spaces across markets.
  
  Brisa Frontier’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each
  linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter. 
  
  *Formerly Brisa Distressed Outdoor. Outdoor applications for Residential use only.*
* [Ellora Cloud Green Thumbnail]
  
  # Brisa Ellora
  
  Brisa Ellora embodies the perfect blend of aesthetics and functionality. Taking its meaning from
  the word “cloud”, its unique breathable technology ensures optimal comfort, making it an ideal
  choice for those who seek both style and substance. The combination of texture, durability, and
  functionality makes Brisa Ellora a premium choice for any space, including seating and acoustic
  applications.
  
  Brisa Ellora’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Brisa Fresco Flipped]
  
  # Fresco
  
  Breathable Comfort. Innovative Features. High-Style.
  Combining style and functionality, Fresco is a breath of fresh air. The collection is engineered
  with our proprietary breathable technology, which promotes airflow for ultimate seating comfort.
  When used with appropriate components, it features sound absorption properties in vertical
  applications. On top of that, inherent antimicrobial technology inhibits the growth of bacteria
  and other surface pathogens. With a texture reminiscent of leather across a palette of rich,
  classic neutrals, Fresco brings life to any design.
  
  Fresco’s blended backcloth includes REPREVE® recycled polyester and ECOVERO™ viscose. Each linear
  yard contains 8.3 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Coast Collections]
  
  # Coast
  
  Coast stands up to the elements while delivering superb style and comfort. Engineered to resist
  water, deflect against mildew and bacteria, and endure regular cleaning and disinfection, it’s
  ideal for outdoor, marine, and commercial spaces. Its enhanced UV resistance ensures colorfastness
  and our unique microfoam layer keeps surfaces cool to the touch. Inspired by the soothing
  qualities of the coastline, this collection features a soft pebble grain with a supple hand and a
  curated palette of natural, organic hues.
  
  Coast’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Pearlized]
  
  # Pearlized
  
  Pearlized adds a little shine to any setting. This fabric combines a classic, natural grain with
  subtle luminescence to deliver both style and luxury. Featuring a silken touch and a selection of
  chic hues, Pearlized is sure to add a distinctive statement to any design. But it’s more than
  beauty alone, this collection is a durable choice for sophisticated, sustainable style.
  
  Supporting our use of rapidly renewable resources, the backcloth of Pearlized contains 100%
  FSC/PEFC Certified Rayon.
* # Promessa
  
  Style meets stamina with Promessa, which features a pebbled texture and subtle sheen across a
  sizable range of neutral and deep tones. Bleach solution cleanable with a blended backcloth and
  industry-leading abrasion resistance, Promessa is ideal for high-traffic upholstery applications.
  Push the possibilities with Promessa.
  
  Promessa’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Pumice]
  
  # Pumice
  
  Profound protection and performance define Pumice. Its EPA-registered anti-mildew, antimicrobial,
  and antibacterial agents prolong the life of your designs. Colorfastness to sunlight,
  perspiration, chlorine, and seawater prevents fading. These powerful performance attributes,
  combined with the fabric’s understated textural surface make Pumice ideal for active settings —
  especially marine seating and high-exposure furniture. Pumice comes in thoughtfully curated
  neutrals sure to fit any color scheme.
  
  Pumice’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Summit]
  
  # Summit
  
  Innovative in both style and functionality, this fabric features moisture repellency, solar
  endurance, colorfastness, climate control technology, and EPA-registered defense against microbes,
  bacteria and mildew.
  
  Summit’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
  
  Summit is ideal for indoor and outdoor applications but is not suitable for marine exterior use.
* [Classic Tottori]
  
  # Tottori
  
  Inspired by the windswept landscape of the Tottori Sand Dunes in Japan, this collection features a
  timeless leather-like grain, matte finish, and a soft hand. Bleach cleanable with superior
  durability and a blended backcloth, Tottori is made to last. Offered in a range of earth-inspired
  shades with natural color variation, Tottori is ready for all upholstery applications across all
  markets.
  
  Tottori’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Ultraleather]
  
  # Ultraleather
  
  Reimagine the experience of leather. With a natural grain that’s soft and supple to the touch,
  Ultraleather boasts superior durability thanks to its 16-week hydrolysis resistance. Available in
  exclusive shades across a wide-ranging color palette, Ultraleather is ideal for any interior
  application.
  
  Supporting our use of rapidly renewable resources, the backcloth of Ultraleather contains 100%
  FSC/PEFC Certified Rayon.
* [Classic Pebble]
  
  # Pebble
  
  Cutting-edge Durability. Anywhere Shades.
  Pebble is meticulously engineered and extremely resilient, providing protection that lasts.
  Ensuring the fabric’s preservation for years on end, Pebble is equipped with EPA-registered
  anti-mildew defense and UV endurance. With its organic granular pattern, Pebble is a timeless
  addition to any design vision, indoors or out. Pebble is available in 2 neutral shades guaranteed
  to fit in anywhere.

  subtle luminescence to deliver both style and luxury. Featuring a silken touch and a selection of
  chic hues, Pearlized is sure to add a distinctive statement to any design. But it’s more than
  beauty alone, this collection is a durable choice for sophisticated, sustainable style.
  
  Supporting our use of rapidly renewable resources, the backcloth of Pearlized contains 100%
  FSC/PEFC Certified Rayon.
* # Promessa
  
  Style meets stamina with Promessa, which features a pebbled texture and subtle sheen across a
  sizable range of neutral and deep tones. Bleach solution cleanable with a blended backcloth and
  industry-leading abrasion resistance, Promessa is ideal for high-traffic upholstery applications.
  Push the possibilities with Promessa.
  
  Promessa’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Pumice]
  
  # Pumice
  
  Profound protection and performance define Pumice. Its EPA-registered anti-mildew, antimicrobial,
  and antibacterial agents prolong the life of your designs. Colorfastness to sunlight,
  perspiration, chlorine, and seawater prevents fading. These powerful performance attributes,
  combined with the fabric’s understated textural surface make Pumice ideal for active settings —
  especially marine seating and high-exposure furniture. Pumice comes in thoughtfully curated
  neutrals sure to fit any color scheme.
  
  Pumice’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Summit]
  
  # Summit
  
  Innovative in both style and functionality, this fabric features moisture repellency, solar
  endurance, colorfastness, climate control technology, and EPA-registered defense against microbes,
  bacteria and mildew.
  
  Summit’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
  
  Summit is ideal for indoor and outdoor applications but is not suitable for marine exterior use.
* [Classic Tottori]
  
  # Tottori
  
  Inspired by the windswept landscape of the Tottori Sand Dunes in Japan, this collection features a
  timeless leather-like grain, matte finish, and a soft hand. Bleach cleanable with superior
  durability and a blended backcloth, Tottori is made to last. Offered in a range of earth-inspired
  shades with natural color variation, Tottori is ready for all upholstery applications across all
  markets.
  
  Tottori’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Ultraleather]
  
  # Ultraleather
  
  Reimagine the experience of leather. With a natural grain that’s soft and supple to the touch,
  Ultraleather boasts superior durability thanks to its 16-week hydrolysis resistance. Available in
  exclusive shades across a wide-ranging color palette, Ultraleather is ideal for any interior
  application.
  
  Supporting our use of rapidly renewable resources, the backcloth of Ultraleather contains 100%
  FSC/PEFC Certified Rayon.
* [Classic Pebble]
  
  # Pebble
  
  Cutting-edge Durability. Anywhere Shades.
  Pebble is meticulously engineered and extremely resilient, providing protection that lasts.
  Ensuring the fabric’s preservation for years on end, Pebble is equipped with EPA-registered
  anti-mildew defense and UV endurance. With its organic granular pattern, Pebble is a timeless
  addition to any design vision, indoors or out. Pebble is available in 2 neutral shades guaranteed
  to fit in anywhere.
